# Setup
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(plm)        # panel estimation
library(lmtest)     # coeftest
library(sandwich)   # vcovHC
```

```{r}
# Set paths
data_directory <- "data/bres/"
output_directory <- "output/"

# Create output directory
if (!dir.exists(output_directory)) dir.create(output_directory, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Data Processing

```{r}
cat("Starting employment data processing...\n")

# Load and combine all CSV files
cat("Loading CSV files...\n")
raw_data <- list.files(data_directory, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(~read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE))

cat("Loaded", nrow(raw_data), "rows from", 
    length(list.files(data_directory, pattern = "\\.csv$")), "files\n")

# Clean and standardize data
cat("Cleaning data...\n")
cleaned_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.numeric(DATE),
    region = str_trim(GEOGRAPHY_NAME),
    industry = str_trim(INDUSTRY_NAME),
    employment = as.numeric(OBS_VALUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(region), 
    !is.na(industry),
    !is.na(employment),
    employment > 0,
    str_detect(EMPLOYMENT_STATUS_NAME, "Employ")
  ) %>%
  select(date, region, industry, employment) %>%
  arrange(date, region, industry)

cat("Cleaned data:", nrow(cleaned_data), "rows\n")
cat("Years:", min(cleaned_data$date), "to", max(cleaned_data$date), "\n")
cat("Regions:", n_distinct(cleaned_data$region), "\n")
cat("Industries:", n_distinct(cleaned_data$industry), "\n")

# Create regional summary
regional_summary <- cleaned_data %>%
  group_by(date, region) %>%
  summarise(
    total_employment = sum(employment),
    num_industries = n_distinct(industry),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create time series matrix
employment_time_series <- cleaned_data %>%
  group_by(date, region) %>%
  summarise(total_employment = sum(employment), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = total_employment) %>%
  arrange(date)
```
#### Related and Unrelated Variety Indexes ####

SIC method
```{r}
cat("Calculating variety indexes (conventional SIC-based method)...\n")

# Prepare data with industry classification levels
employment_with_codes <- cleaned_data %>%
  mutate(
    # extract numeric SIC code (assumes it starts each string)
    sic_code      = str_extract(industry, "^\\d{4}"),     # 4‑digit
    industry_4dig = sic_code,
    industry_2dig = str_sub(sic_code, 1, 2)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(industry_2dig)) %>%
  group_by(date, region) %>%
  mutate(
    total_emp      = sum(employment),
    share_4dig     = employment / total_emp
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Related Variety (RV) – within 2‑digit groups
rv_tbl <- employment_with_codes %>%
  group_by(date, region, industry_2dig) %>%
  mutate(
    group_share        = sum(share_4dig),
    within_shares      = share_4dig / group_share,
    within_entropy_4d  = ifelse(group_share > 0,
                                -within_shares * log2(within_shares + 1e-12), 0)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_entropy = sum(within_entropy_4d),       # Σ p_i log p_i inside each 2‑digit
    group_share      = unique(group_share),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(date, region) %>%
  summarise(
    related_variety = sum(group_share * weighted_entropy),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Unrelated Variety (UV) – across 2‑digit groups
uv_tbl <- employment_with_codes %>%
  group_by(date, region, industry_2dig) %>%
  summarise(group_share = sum(share_4dig), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(date, region) %>%
  summarise(
    unrelated_variety = -sum(group_share * log2(group_share + 1e-12)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Total Variety (TV) across all 4‑digit industries
tv_tbl <- employment_with_codes %>%
  group_by(date, region) %>%
  summarise(
    total_variety = -sum(share_4dig * log2(share_4dig + 1e-12)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge & sense check
variety_indexes <- rv_tbl %>%
  left_join(uv_tbl, by = c("date", "region")) %>%
  left_join(tv_tbl, by = c("date", "region")) %>%
  mutate(check_tv = abs(total_variety - (related_variety + unrelated_variety)) < 1e-8) # should be true for every region-time combo

# 4-year rolling mean (unweighted) for each region
avg_1519 <- variety_indexes %>% 
  filter(date %in% 2015:2019) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(
    RV_avg = mean(related_variety),
    UV_avg = mean(unrelated_variety),
    TV_avg = mean(total_variety)) %>%
  mutate(check_tv = abs(TV_avg - (RV_avg + UV_avg)) < 1e-8) # TRUE for every combo as above

```

#### Dynamic Shift-Share estimates ####

```{r}
# Helper
compute_growth <- function(start, end) {
  (end - start) / ifelse(start == 0, NA, start)
}

compute_shiftshare <- function(df, start_year, end_year, phase_name) {
  # snapshots
  base <- df %>% filter(date == start_year)
  end  <- df %>% filter(date == end_year)

  # national growth
  g_nat <- compute_growth(sum(base$employment), sum(end$employment))

  g_nat_i <- base %>%
    group_by(industry) %>% summarise(E_i0 = sum(employment), .groups="drop") %>%
    left_join(end  %>% group_by(industry) %>% summarise(E_i1 = sum(employment), .groups="drop"),
              by = "industry") %>%
    mutate(g_nat_i = compute_growth(E_i0, E_i1)) %>%
    select(industry, g_nat_i)

  # region–industry growth
  g_ri <- base %>%
    select(region, industry, emp0 = employment) %>%
    left_join(end %>% select(region, industry, emp1 = employment),
              by = c("region", "industry")) %>%
    mutate(g_ri = compute_growth(emp0, emp1))

  # regional totals
  base_reg <- base %>% group_by(region) %>% summarise(E_start = sum(employment), .groups="drop")
  end_reg  <- end  %>% group_by(region) %>% summarise(E_end   = sum(employment), .groups="drop")

  # shift–share terms
  ss <- g_ri %>%
    left_join(g_nat_i, by = "industry") %>%
    left_join(base_reg, by = "region") %>%
    mutate(
      NE = E_start * g_nat,
      IM = emp0 * (g_nat_i - g_nat),
      CE = emp0 * (g_ri   - g_nat_i)
    ) %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarise(
      NE  = unique(NE),
      IM  = sum(IM, na.rm = TRUE),
      CE  = sum(CE, na.rm = TRUE),
      E_start = unique(E_start),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(end_reg, by = "region") %>%
    mutate(
      delta_emp = E_end - E_start,
      phase     = phase_name,
      start_year = start_year,
      end_year   = end_year
    )
  ss
}

# run for each phase
phases <- list(
  list(s = 2019, e = 2020, name = "2019_20"),
  list(s = 2020, e = 2022, name = "2020_22")
)

shiftshare_results <- purrr::map_dfr(phases, ~compute_shiftshare(cleaned_data, .x$s, .x$e, .x$name))

# normalise outputs for regression
shiftshare_scaled <- shiftshare_results %>%
  mutate(
    CE_prop    = CE / E_start,
    IM_prop    = IM / E_start,
    NE_prop    = NE / E_start,
    delta_prop = delta_emp / E_start
  )

# Overall dynamic shift-share analysis results 
dynamic_shiftshare_results <- shiftshare_results %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    NE_dynamic  = sum(NE, na.rm = TRUE),                #sum of national effects across years
    IM_dynamic  = sum(IM, na.rm = TRUE),                # sums the industry mix effects
    CE_dynamic  = sum(CE, na.rm = TRUE),                # sums the competitive effects
    delta_emp_dynamic = sum(delta_emp, na.rm = TRUE),
    E_start_2015 = first(E_start),  # First year employment
    E_end_2022   = last(E_end),     # Final year employment
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CE_prop    = CE_dynamic / E_start_2015, 
    IM_prop    = IM_dynamic / E_start_2015,
    NE_prop    = NE_dynamic / E_start_2015,
    delta_prop = delta_emp_dynamic / E_start_2015
  )
```

#### CE regression ####

```{r}
# Merge CE + variety
panel_df <- shiftshare_scaled %>%
  left_join(avg_1519, by = "region") %>%
  mutate(
    phase_dummy = ifelse(phase == "2020_22", 1, 0),
    RV_int      = RV_avg * phase_dummy,   # interaction term
    UV_int      = UV_avg * phase_dummy
  )

# Set up panel data frame
# two periods per region → indexed by (region, phase)
plm_df <- pdata.frame(panel_df, index = c("region", "phase"))

# Fixed‑effects (within) estimator
fe_mod <- plm(CE_prop ~ RV_avg + UV_avg + IM_prop + phase_dummy + RV_int + UV_int,
             data = plm_df, model = "within", effect = "individual")

#  Cluster‑robust SEs
coefs <- coeftest(fe_mod, vcov = vcovHC(fe_mod, type = "HC1", cluster = "group"))
print(coefs)

# Save results
results_path <- file.path(output_directory, "ce_rv_regression_results.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame(coefs), results_path, row.names = TRUE)
cat("Results saved to", results_path, "\n")

```

```{r}

# Merge CE/IM with 2015‑19 average RV & UV
panel <- dplyr::left_join(shiftshare_scaled, avg_1519, by = "region")

# Helper: fit model, build tidy coefficient table manually (had issues with coeftest)
run_phase_lm <- function(df, phase_label) {
  mod <- lm(CE_prop ~ RV_avg + UV_avg + IM_prop, data = df)

  # keep only non‑NA coefficients (lm drops collinear terms)
  beta <- coef(mod)
  keep <- !is.na(beta)
  beta <- beta[keep]

  # robust HC1 covariance matrix, subset to kept coefficients
  V <- sandwich::vcovHC(mod, type = "HC1")[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
  se <- sqrt(diag(V))
  t  <- beta / se
  p  <- 2 * pt(abs(t), df = mod$df.residual, lower.tail = FALSE)

  tidy <- data.frame(term = names(beta), estimate = beta,
                     std.error = se, t.value = t, p.value = p)
  print(tidy)
  
  outfile <- file.path(output_directory,
                       paste0("ce_rv_results_", phase_label, ".csv"))
  write.csv(tidy, outfile, row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved results to ", outfile)

  list(model = mod, coefs = tidy)
}

# 2019->20 impact phase
impact_df <- dplyr::filter(panel, phase == "2019_20")
impact_res <- run_phase_lm(impact_df, "2019_20")

# 2020->22 rebound phase
rebound_df <- dplyr::filter(panel, phase == "2020_22")
rebound_res <- run_phase_lm(rebound_df, "2020_22")
```
